# Hook points and fields: rac3

Every hook point a mod can take ([hooks](../hooks.md)), and the game state exposed to
scripts by name. Signatures use `void i32 u32 i64 u64 f32 i16 u16 i8 u8`; `u32` is also a
game address.

## Hook points

| Id | Name | Signature | Parameters | Discs |  |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `rac3.player.take_damage` | `Hero_TakeDamage` | `void(i32)` | amount | pal, ntsc | Takes a hit's points from the hero's health (the s32 at 0x001A7430, hero +0x2850), scaled by the armour's factor and the help measure's, at least 1 and never below 0 (hero_damage); the hero's hit reaction calls it for each hit. Going Commando's rac2.player.take_damage. |
| `rac3.item.give` | `Item_Give` | `void(i32)` | id | pal, ntsc | Gives the player item id (item_give): its owned and new bytes (0x00142CA0, 0x00142D40, a byte per item), its row's starting ammo to a gun that has none, the vendor's list (Vendor_StockAdd) and the quick select. Givers, purchases and each level's start (Level_GiveItems) go through it. |
| `rac3.item.upgrade` | `Item_Upgrade` | `i32(i32)` | id | pal, ntsc | The vendor's Mega upgrade of item id (weapon_buy_mega): its level set to 5, its ammo filled, its experience cleared. The vendor calls it after the price is paid; a replacement can carry out its own upgrade. |
| `rac3.weapon.level_up` | `Weapon_LevelUp` | `void(i32)` | id | pal, ntsc | Steps weapon id to its next level (weapon_level_up): its row (the item's byte at 0x001425C0) moves along the row's +0x46, its experience is raised to the old row's step and its ammo filled. A replacement that does not call the original blocks the step. |
| `rac3.weapon.take_ammo` | `Weapon_TakeAmmo` | `i32(i32,i32)` | item, amount | pal, ntsc | Takes rounds of a gun's ammo (ammo_use; item -1: the one in hand): 1 when there were enough, 0 otherwise; always 1 for a gun without a maximum. Every gun calls it as it fires. Rac1's TakeAmmo. |
| `rac3.weapon.add_ammo` | `Weapon_AddAmmo` | `i32(i32,i32)` | item, amount | pal, ntsc | Adds rounds to a gun's ammo (ammo_add, the words at 0x001427F0), capped at its row's maximum (+0x8A); returns what did not fit. Ammo pickups and the vendor call it. |
| `rac3.vendor.price` | `Vendor_Price` | `i32()` |  | pal, ntsc | The price in bolts of the vendor's row under the cursor (vendor_price): the gun's (+0x7C of its row), its level-5 row's for a Mega row, 9/10 of it with the discount. The vendor's screen and the purchase both ask it. |
| `rac3.vendor.build_list` | `Vendor_BuildList` | `i32(i32)` | mode | pal, ntsc | Fills the vendor's weapons rows from its stock (vendor_weapon_list): a rounds row for each owned gun that is not full, a special row, a row for each gun for sale (Mega rows in challenge mode), and keeps the cursor on its item. The vendor calls it as it opens and after a purchase. |
| `rac3.vendor.stock_add` | `Vendor_StockAdd` | `i32(i32)` | id | pal, ntsc | Lists item id for the vendor (vendor_stock_add; vendor_stock at 0x001D54D8, a u16 per entry: the item, bit 15 owned, bit 14 not yet for sale). Item_Give calls it. |
| `rac3.moby.record_death` | `Moby_RecordDeath` | `void(u32,i32,i32)` | moby, hit, killer | pal, ntsc | An enemy's death (moby_killed): its class's experience to the gun that killed it (by its damage record), the hero's experience and its bolt drop (Bolt_SpawnPickups). Enemies call it as they die. Going Commando's rac2.moby.record_death. |
| `rac3.combat.post_hit` | `Moby_PostHit` | `void(u32,u32)` | victim, record | pal, ntsc | Queues a damage record (a game address) for moby victim in the hit ring (damage_queue; 0x001EED00, 64 entries): a moby keeps one pending (+0xA8), which a hit at least as strong replaces and a weaker one only adds its flags to. The guns and the shock mod call it. Going Commando's rac2.combat.post_hit. |
| `rac3.bolt.spawn_pickups` | `Bolt_SpawnPickups` | `void(u32,i32,i32,i32,i32,i32,f32)` | moby, low, high, flags, surface, maximum, height | pal, ntsc | Spawns a burst of bolt coins from moby (bolts_drop): an amount from low to high split into the biggest coins that fit, each made by Bolt_SpawnPickup; flag 8 at most maximum coins (the rest banked, 0x0014269C). Enemies' drops (Moby_Killed) and the levels' scripted bursts come here. A replacement can change low and high, or make the coins itself. |
| `rac3.bolt.spawn_pickup` | `Bolt_SpawnPickup` | `i32(i32,i32,i32,i32,i32,i32)` | source, position, velocity, flags, value, counted | pal, ntsc | Makes one bolt coin worth value at position with velocity (game addresses of four floats each) from source (bolt_coin_spawn): its moby, or 0; 64 units or more from the camera the value is banked instead. |
| `rac3.bolt.collect` | `Bolt_Collect` | `i32(i32)` | moby | pal, ntsc | A bolt coin collected (bolt_pickup_collect): its value added to the player's bolts (0x00142660), the bolt HUD shown for 180 frames and its sparkle. The coin's update calls it as it reaches the hero. A replacement can add more with openrac_api.bolts. |
| `rac3.level.load` | `Level_Load` | `i32()` |  | pal, ntsc | The way to the next level (level_load, each level's copy): picks the transition for the level asked for, sets level_current (0x001D545C) and starts reading its files. Going Commando's rac2.level.load. |
| `rac3.level.give_items` | `Level_GiveItems` | `void()` |  | pal, ntsc | A level's start (give_level_items): the standing items (the suit, the camera options, the thruster-pack) through Item_Give, then the level's own. Every level calls it as it starts. |
| `rac3.player.death_done` | `Hero_DeathDone` | `void()` |  | pal, ntsc | The hero's death over (hero_death_done: state 57 ended, or a fall out of the level): the death counted in the stats and the respawn asked for (0x001A71D2), which the level carries out at the end of the frame. |
